rows.text: fills 0x10 dwords at `02098E10 + 0x204 + ecx * 0x288` (`ecx` sign-extended) with 0xFFFFFFFF when `edx` is non-zero and with 0 when `edx` is zero, using `rep stosd`

returns 0 for `edx` above 7 (unsigned); otherwise jumps through an 8-entry case table whose case-to-arm mapping the listing does not decode, to arms that: test bit 1 of byte `+0x318` of the `0x160`-byte record `r9d` at `rcx` and return 0 after `00249C60(5)` when it is set, else 1 after `00249C60(0x15)`; call `0029B440(0035BB00(r8d))` and `00249C60(1)` and return 1; or return 0 after `00249C60(5)` when `00299B90(signed word +0x14 of 0035D320())` is zero, else call `0035BC30()` and `00249C60(3)` and return 1

notes: 00297640: the case table's contents are not decoded in the pack, so the row names no case numbers; some cases may target the plain 'return 0' tail directly. OPUS should confirm the case mapping at the bytes if the page needs it. 0026B870: the listing prints the anchor mnemonic as 'rep' (rep stosd).
